entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, my ID is 301. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. Um, I think I need to send something back. I'm a little lost with your website, it was all very confusing. I received this box a few days ago.
I can certainly help you with that. To pull up your account, could I please get your name and order number?
Yes, it's Maria Valenti. The order number is... VF... 8... 6... 7... 5... 3... 0... 9.

Thank you, Maria. I see your order for the Aero-Dynamic Helmet, delivered on January 6th. To make sure I'm assisting you correctly, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, I don't know, a preference, I guess? The color just isn't what I expected from the pictures online. I'm so overwhelmed. The box is still unopened, I haven't even taken it out. Can't you just help me?

Of course, Maria. I completely understand. Sometimes the way a color appears on a screen can be a bit different from how it looks in person. Since you're well within the 90-day return window for standard items, processing a return is no problem at all.
Really? That's it? Oh, thank goodness. What do I do now?

It's a very simple process. I have just initiated the return authorization in our system. You will receive an email in the next few minutes with a prepaid shipping label. Just print that out, attach it to the box, and drop it off at the post office. We want to ensure you're completely happy with your gear, especially something as critical for your safety as a helmet.
Wow, that's much easier than I thought it would be. Thank you so much for your help, Isaac.
You are very welcome, Maria. Once we receive the item, we'll process a full refund to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
